_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, and timeshare properties in 139 countries and territories under 30 brand names'; 'COVID-19 has had a material detrimental impact on our business and financial results, and such impact could continue and may worsen for an unknown period of time'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully for guests'; 'Each of our hotel brands and our home rental offering competes with major hotel chains, regional hotel chains, independent hotels, and home sharing and rental services across national and international venues'; 'Economic downturns and other global, national, and regional conditions could further impact our financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business' (its own FY2021 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, and timeshare properties in 139 countries and territories under 30 brand names'; 'COVID-19 has had a material detrimental impact on our business and financial results, and such impact could continue and may worsen for an unknown period of time'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully for guests'; 'Each of our hotel brands and our home rental offering competes with major hotel chains, regional hotel chains, independent hotels, and home sharing and rental services across national and international venues'; 'Economic downturns and other global, national, and regional conditions could further impact our financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business' (its own FY2021 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.55x; +25% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.22; conservative 2yr +65%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -29.4%/yr (worst year FY12-FY21 ex-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +30.1%/yr (Q4 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 median

BULL.desc: EPS +30.1%/yr (FY12-FY21 ex-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +40.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY21 ex-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2022-11-11) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.55x (57.9% downside to Bear $69 / +105.8% upside to Bull $337) | Adj composite 3.93 vs market 1.71: gap +2.22 [UNDERVALUED] | +25% above the EPP floor $131 (20x FY22E $6.54) | Conservative 2-yr case: +65.4% total (+32.7%/yr) | At 25.0x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $217 sits at or below the BASE case; North American RevPAR +41.2% in Q3 2022, forward fee revenue +28.76-31.17% (Q4 2022 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
